title: Images share layers: stored once, used many times
subtitle: Three images built FROM node:24-slim. Each says 341MB, but the base layers are on your disk only once.

nodes.label: node:24-slim layers
nodes.detail:
Debian + Node.js + npm
330MB · stored once, shared by all three

notes.text:
Pick a small base image: every image you build on it carries its size.

And keep junk out of the build with .dockerignore: a 50MB video copied by COPY . . becomes a 50MB layer.

docker images node
# node:24         1.65GB
# node:24-slim     333MB
# node:24-alpine   244MB

docker system df -v
# SIZE / SHARED SIZE / UNIQUE SIZE
